construction.source_design: Adapted from projmix-configs while replacing direct latent Gaussian cross-block covariance by a two-layer latent-regime construction.
construction.model_definition: p(x_linear,x_directional)=sum_j pi_j N(x_linear;mu_j,Sigma_j) sum_k alpha_jk PG(x_directional;eta_jk,Omega_jk), with K=3 and L=2.

first_layer_rule.low_means_and_covariances: Reuse the linear blocks of the original semi-projected-Gaussian configuration.
first_layer_rule.high_separability_mean_rule: Scale every first-layer mean offset from the unweighted low-case center by 6.0; keep first-layer covariances fixed.

second_layer_rule.high_separability_angle_rule: Multiply every low-case angular offset from the common anchor by 2.25, so all nonzero pairwise angles among the six pre-projection mean directions are multiplied by 2.25.
second_layer_rule.covariance_rule: Pre-projection directional covariance depends only on subtype k and is shared across regimes j and all factor levels.
second_layer_rule.independent_case_rule: All three regimes use exactly the same conditional weights, pre-projection means, and pre-projection covariances; therefore p(X_directional|Y1=j) is identical for all j and the two observed blocks are marginally independent.

dependence_factor_interpretation.strong: The three first-layer regimes have fully separated directional-mixture centers.
dependence_factor_interpretation.weak: Regime-specific directional center offsets are one third of the strong offsets.
dependence_factor_interpretation.independent: Regime-specific directional center offsets are zero and all conditional directional mixtures are identical.
dependence_factor_interpretation.important_note: There is no Gaussian cross-covariance in this generator. By construction, X_linear and X_directional are conditionally independent given Y1; dependence is mediated only through the first-layer latent regime.

construction.dimension_extension_rule: The 3d first-layer means and covariances reuse the original 3d linear blocks. The 3d directional means lie on a tilted great circle in R^3, which makes the angular scaling rule exact while using all three ambient coordinates.

observation_noise_protocol.rule: For each clean dataset, optionally apply the same paired observation-noise protocol as in the original experiment: isotropic Gaussian noise scaled by the maximum empirical coordinate standard deviation of the corresponding latent block, followed by renormalization of the directional block.

checks_performed: Symmetry and strict positive definiteness of every first-layer and pre-projection directional covariance matrix.
Exact factor-6 scaling of all first-layer pairwise mean distances from low to high separability.
Exact factor-2.25 scaling of every nonzero pairwise angle among the six projected-Gaussian mean directions from low to high separability.
Exact equality of the three conditional directional mixtures in every independent case.
Ordering of regime-directional separation: strong > weak > independent.
Monte Carlo sanity checks that high separability improves first-layer Bayes classification and conditional second-layer nearest-direction recovery.
